caption:
Lists have to match. This one doesn't.

"Planting trees, painting fences, and clearing trails." Stack the list items: if one sticks out, it's the error.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Every item in a list has to match. Stack them to check.

youtube.title: Parallel Structure on the SAT: Make Lists Match
youtube.description: Items in a list need the same grammatical form. Stack them on top of each other and fix the one that sticks out.
